review:
Egyptian gods in shimmering sci-fi armour on an unusual octagonal cluster grid. Wins tumble, and wilds can blow up every symbol around them when they set off a tumble – even ones that aren't in the win.

Money symbols from 0.5x to 1,000x can land, and four or more start three respins where only money and blanks land. Up to 10,000x. Note the 95.97% RTP. A distinctive look.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
